description: This file defines a class GCSBucketBase that manages interactions with Google Cloud Storage (GCS), including constructing request headers, downloading, deleting objects, and logging data to GCS. It integrates with Vertex AI for authentication and caching vertex instances.

classes.name: GCSBucketBase
classes.description: A class for managing Google Cloud Storage interactions, including authentication, object download, deletion, and logging, with integration to Vertex AI.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes GCSBucketBase with optional bucket name and sets up HTTP client and environment variables.

methods.name: construct_request_headers
methods.description: Constructs authorization headers for GCS API requests using Vertex AI credentials.

methods.name: sync_construct_request_headers
methods.description: Synchronously constructs request headers for GCS API calls, using environment variables.

methods.name: _handle_folders_in_bucket_name
methods.description: Handles bucket names with folder postfixes, splitting into bucket name and object path.

methods.name: get_gcs_logging_config
methods.description: Retrieves GCS logging configuration, including bucket name and vertex instance, based on dynamic parameters or defaults.

methods.name: get_or_create_vertex_instance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches a VertexBase instance for authentication.

methods.name: _get_in_memory_key_for_vertex_instance
methods.description: Generates cache key for VertexBase instance based on credentials.

methods.name: download_gcs_object
methods.description: Downloads an object from GCS, returning its content.

methods.name: _log_json_data_on_gcs
methods.description: Uploads JSON data to GCS as a log entry.
